what is granite | how does granite form | how is granite made | granite rock => Granite forms when magma cools slowly deep underground, so it has big crystals of quartz, feldspar and mica. It's very hard and is used for kitchen counters, buildings and monuments.
what type of rock is granite | is granite igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | granite rock type => Granite is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is basalt | how does basalt form | how is basalt made | basalt rock => Basalt is a dark rock formed when lava cools quickly at the surface. Most of the ocean floor is basalt, and it's crushed for roads and railway beds. The Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland is made of basalt columns.
what type of rock is basalt | is basalt igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | basalt rock type => Basalt is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is obsidian | how does obsidian form | how is obsidian made | obsidian rock => Obsidian is natural volcanic glass, made when lava cools so fast that no crystals form. Its edges can be sharper than steel, so ancient people made blades and arrowheads from it.
what type of rock is obsidian | is obsidian igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | obsidian rock type => Obsidian is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is pumice | how does pumice form | how is pumice made | pumice rock => Pumice forms when frothy, gas-filled lava cools quickly, trapping lots of bubbles. It's so full of holes it can float on water. It's used to scrub skin and in some concrete.
what type of rock is pumice | is pumice igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | pumice rock type => Pumice is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is rhyolite | how does rhyolite form | how is rhyolite made | rhyolite rock => Rhyolite is a light colored volcanic rock with the same minerals as granite but tiny crystals, because it cooled fast. Very sticky rhyolite magma can cause explosive eruptions.
what type of rock is rhyolite | is rhyolite igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | rhyolite rock type => Rhyolite is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is andesite | how does andesite form | how is andesite made | andesite rock => Andesite is a gray volcanic rock, between basalt and rhyolite. It's named after the Andes mountains. It's common in volcanoes above subduction zones, like around the Pacific Ring of Fire.
what type of rock is andesite | is andesite igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | andesite rock type => Andesite is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.

what type of rock is gabbro | is gabbro igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | gabbro rock type => Gabbro is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is diorite | how does diorite form | how is diorite made | diorite rock => Diorite is a speckled black and white igneous rock that cooled slowly underground. Ancient Egyptians and others carved it into statues and vases.
what type of rock is diorite | is diorite igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | diorite rock type => Diorite is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.

what type of rock is tuff | is tuff igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | tuff rock type => Tuff is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.

what type of rock is scoria | is scoria igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | scoria rock type => Scoria is an igneous rock, made from cooled magma or lava.
what is sandstone | how does sandstone form | how is sandstone made | sandstone rock => Sandstone forms when layers of sand get buried and the grains are cemented together over time. It's used for buildings, and canyons like the Grand Canyon have thick sandstone layers.
what type of rock is sandstone | is sandstone igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | sandstone rock type => Sandstone is a sedimentary rock, made from layers of bits that were pressed and cemented together.

what type of rock is shale | is shale igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | shale rock type => Shale is a sedimentary rock, made from layers of bits that were pressed and cemented together.

what type of rock is conglomerate | is conglomerate igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | conglomerate rock type => Conglomerate is a sedimentary rock, made from layers of bits that were pressed and cemented together.
what is breccia | how does breccia form | how is breccia made | breccia rock => Breccia is made of sharp, angular rock pieces cemented together. The sharp pieces show they didn't travel far before being buried.
what type of rock is breccia | is breccia igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | breccia rock type => Breccia is a sedimentary rock, made from layers of bits that were pressed and cemented together.

how does rock salt form | how is rock salt made => Rock salt forms when salty seas or lakes evaporate and leave thick salt layers. It's mined for table salt and for melting ice on roads.

what is marble | how does marble form | how is marble made | marble rock => Marble forms when limestone is heated and squeezed, so its crystals grow and lock together. It's used for sculptures and buildings, like Michelangelo's David and the Taj Mahal.
what type of rock is marble | is marble igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | marble rock type => Marble is a metamorphic rock, changed by heat and pressure.
what is slate | how does slate form | how is slate made | slate rock => Slate forms when shale is squeezed, so it splits into flat, thin sheets. It's used for roof tiles, floors and old school chalkboards.
what type of rock is slate | is slate igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | slate rock type => Slate is a metamorphic rock, changed by heat and pressure.
what is schist | how does schist form | how is schist made | schist rock => Schist is a sparkly metamorphic rock with flat layers of mica, formed under more heat and pressure than slate. It can contain garnets.
what type of rock is schist | is schist igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | schist rock type => Schist is a metamorphic rock, changed by heat and pressure.
what is gneiss | how does gneiss form | how is gneiss made | gneiss rock => Gneiss is a metamorphic rock with light and dark bands, made under very high heat and pressure. Some of the oldest rocks on Earth, over 4 billion years old in Canada, are gneiss.
what type of rock is gneiss | is gneiss igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | gneiss rock type => Gneiss is a metamorphic rock, changed by heat and pressure.

what is soapstone | how does soapstone form | how is soapstone made | soapstone rock => Soapstone is a soft metamorphic rock made mostly of talc, so it feels soapy. It's easy to carve and holds heat well, so it's used for sculptures, sinks and stoves.
what type of rock is soapstone | is soapstone igneous sedimentary or metamorphic | soapstone rock type => Soapstone is a metamorphic rock, changed by heat and pressure.
